scenarios.name: cold-start-show
scenarios.note: An empty install fetches, verifies, writes the set, then adopts and displays it.

scenarios.name: shown-twice
scenarios.note: A second SHOWN while already visible does not redraw or start another attempt.

scenarios.name: hidden-mid-attempt
scenarios.note: Hiding during a signed-file attempt cancels it and leaves no timer running.

scenarios.name: late-reply-after-hide
scenarios.note: A completion from a cancelled generation is ignored after the view hides.

scenarios.name: killswitch-under-pointer
scenarios.note: A committed kill switch swaps immediately even while the pointer is over the banner.

scenarios.name: fresh-under-pointer-waits
scenarios.note: A fresh online set waits for pointer exit, then swaps with a non-immediate display.

scenarios.name: expiry-while-visible
scenarios.note: Visible expiry swaps directly to DaGoat after the expiry timer has fired; no disarm is emitted.

scenarios.name: visible-24h-check
scenarios.note: A visible banner checks at lastCheck plus 24 hours while a 20-hour SHOWN is not yet due.

scenarios.name: backoff-6-12-24
scenarios.note: Retries occur at 6, 12 and 24 hours, and failures remain capped at three.

scenarios.name: crash-before-record
scenarios.note: A crash after set write but before record write restarts from the old record and banner.

scenarios.name: hwm-below-floor
scenarios.note: START raises a persisted high-water mark below the compiled floor before continuing.

scenarios.name: click-expired
scenarios.note: Clicking at the exact expiry swaps to DaGoat and does not open the old link.

scenarios.name: resume-after-expiry
scenarios.note: RESUME handles an expired online banner before considering a fresh check.

scenarios.name: start-clock-ahead
scenarios.note: START invalidates a persisted banner that is already expired under the startup clock.

scenarios.name: mayfetch-false
scenarios.note: A false fetch gate suppresses polling until a later SHOWN carries true.

scenarios.name: expiry-30s-exact
scenarios.note: The exact 30-second expiry is armed without a one-minute clamp, then the next check is armed.

scenarios.name: photo-after-expiry
scenarios.note: Photos completing after expiry fail the attempt without writing a set, then record the failure.

scenarios.name: storage-write-fails
scenarios.note: A failed set write leaves the old current and high-water mark while recording one failure.

scenarios.name: clock-behind-last-check
scenarios.note: A clock moving behind lastCheckMs makes the next visible SHOWN due immediately.

scenarios.name: expiry-while-pending
scenarios.note: Expiry overrides a pointer-held fresh swap and goes straight to the already committed replacement.

scenarios.name: late-reply-after-reshow
scenarios.note: A stale reply from the first visibility attempt is ignored after a reshow starts generation two.

scenarios.name: start-set-invalid
scenarios.note: START clears a current set that startup verification rejected and writes the cleared record once.

scenarios.name: start-revision-mismatch
scenarios.note: START clears a verified-shape set whose revision does not equal the persisted high-water mark.

scenarios.name: start-null-record-floor
scenarios.note: A null record starts at the compiled floor without emitting a persistence write.

scenarios.name: precommit-revision-below-hwm
scenarios.note: A show result below hwm can fetch photos but fails at pre-commit, recording a failure without writing a set.

scenarios.name: pending-hide-reshow
scenarios.note: A hidden view forgets a deferred swap; the next SHOWN draws the newly committed set immediately.

scenarios.name: check-timer-clamp-low
scenarios.note: A check due in thirty seconds is clamped to the minimum sixty-second timer window.

scenarios.name: two-kinds
scenarios.note: A client drawing both formats fetches both photos and persists both committed hashes.

scenarios.name: focus-defers-swap
scenarios.note: Focus inside defers a fresh online swap; focus outside applies it non-immediately.

scenarios.name: click-opens
scenarios.note: A click before expiry on a valid online display opens its link.

scenarios.name: timer-while-hidden
scenarios.note: TIMER and RESUME events after HIDDEN are ignored and produce no effects.

scenarios.name: commit-resets-failures
scenarios.note: A successful commit resets a previously failing record to zero failures.
